checkpoints.step: Unlike APPR (province-based, 730/1095/2190 days) and EU (country-based, 365-3650 days),
checkpoints.expected: ASL has a SINGLE fixed limitation period of 1,460 days (4 years) regardless of origin. This makes the ASL limitation check the simplest of all three regimes. DDS RESPONSE CODE = SoC-ASL-NE-08
